R1_ALL_VALID_TELEMETRY.description: All non-constant, non-duplicate sensors including commanded speed and lever position.
R1_ALL_VALID_TELEMETRY.intended_use: Baseline: evaluates unconditioned clustering recovery of combined speed and plant state.

R2_WITHOUT_OPERATING_DEMAND.description: Telemetry features with direct commanded setpoints (lp, v) excluded.
R2_WITHOUT_OPERATING_DEMAND.intended_use: Tests whether clustering recovers operating regimes indirectly through coupled physics.

R3_REDUCED_CORRELATION.description: Pruned collinear feature subset (|r| < 0.985) across distinct thermodynamic subsystems.
R3_REDUCED_CORRELATION.intended_use: Evaluates whether removing collinear redundancy sharpens cluster separation in distance metrics.

R4_ROBUST_SCALED_TELEMETRY.description: Telemetry scaled via RobustScaler (median centering, IQR scaling) to limit boundary distortion.
R4_ROBUST_SCALED_TELEMETRY.intended_use: Evaluates sensitivity of distance metrics to operational boundary extremes.

R5_WITHIN_SPEED_NORMALIZED.description: Telemetry features conditionally normalized (mean=0, std=1) within each discrete operating speed regime.
R5_WITHIN_SPEED_NORMALIZED.intended_use: Primary hypothesis: isolates subtle component degradation signatures from dominant speed variance.
